slides.title: Pivot = [[ghumao]]
slides.note: Report padhne mein **10x easy**: ek nazar mein poori picture 👀

slides.title: Har city = [[ek SUM]]
slides.code:
SELECT dept,
 SUM(CASE WHEN city='Delhi'
   THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS delhi,
 SUM(CASE WHEN city='Mumbai'
   THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mumbai,
 SUM(CASE WHEN city='Pune'
   THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pune
FROM employees GROUP BY dept;

slides.title: Recipe [[yaad]] rakho
points: 2. Column mein kya? → har value ka **CASE**

slides.title: CASE vs [[PIVOT]]
slides.note: Nayi city aayi? CASE mein **naya column** khud jodna padega

slides.wrong: Har city ke liye **alag query**: Delhi ki ek, Mumbai ki ek, Pune ki ek
slides.why: 3 query = 3 baar table scan + jodne ka jhanjhat. Pivot ek baar mein 🔥

points: Excel pivot jaisa, ek query mein
